paper_metadata.title: An Intermediate Temperature Creep Model for Ni-based Superalloys

evidence.quote: A mathematical model to predict creep properties of Ni-based superalloys at intermediate temperature ranges based on microstructure, process and creep condition, and material properties has been developed

evidence.section: 3. Parameters for the minimum creep rate model
evidence.quote: the comparison is made for three Ni-based superalloys: N18, René 88 DT, and Udimet 720Li (Wlodek et al., 1992; Krueger et al., 1992; Hessel et al., 2000) (Table 1)

evidence.section: 3. Parameters for the minimum creep rate model
evidence.quote: The composition of γ and γ′ phases is also experimentally available for N18 (Wlodek et al., 1992) and René 88 DT (Wlodek et al., 1996)

evidence.section: 3. Parameters for the minimum creep rate model
evidence.quote: The quantities for the Udimet 720Li are calculated at 725 oC (Hessel et al., 2000).

evidence.section: 3. Parameters for the minimum creep rate model
evidence.quote: The values of model parameters A1 and A2 are obtained by fitting existing experimental minimum creep rate data for René 95 (Bhowal et al., 1990).
